# Selected model probe

Run in a disposable OpenCode 2.2.7 project with the built package installed at `../node_modules/feature-pilot`, and a synthetic `smoke/model-one#high` model configured. Register this directory as a local plugin. It writes synthetic role selections, checks that an unselected role is denied, creates an allowed session, then verifies a native variant change and a removed role selection block prompt submission without inference. Never point a test fixture at a paid provider.
